description: This file defines classes and enums related to process information management, including process memory stats, process iteration, and process control functionalities within the Thunder::Core namespace.

classes.name: ProcessInfo
classes.description: Represents information about a process, including memory stats, priority, policy, and control methods.

classes.name: ProcessCurrent
classes.description: Derived class providing information and control over the current process.

classes.name: ProcessTree
classes.description: Represents a tree of processes, allowing containment checks and retrieval of process IDs.

classes.name: Memory
classes.description: Nested class within ProcessInfo for managing process memory statistics.

classes.name: Iterator
classes.description: Nested class within ProcessInfo for iterating over processes based on various criteria.

methods.name: MemoryStats
methods.description: Updates memory statistics for the process.

methods.name: USS
methods.description: Returns the unique set size memory metric.

methods.name: PSS
methods.description: Returns the proportional set size memory metric.

methods.name: RSS
methods.description: Returns the resident set size memory metric.

methods.name: VSS
methods.description: Returns the virtual set size memory metric.

methods.name: FindByName
methods.description: Finds processes by name and populates a list of ProcessInfo objects.

methods.name: Dump
methods.description: Triggers a dump signal for the process, used for debugging hang detection.
